hypotheses.title: 1-Year Call VRP with 90d Parkinson Realized Baseline (implied_volatility_call_360) (option8)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly builds on the breakthrough of Batch 171 Candidate 2 (which achieved Turnover 11.56%, Sub-universe Sharpe 0.94, Sharpe 1.14, and 0.00 Self-Correlation with zero warnings). Extending the Parkinson realized volatility baseline from 60 days to 90 days (1 full quarter) filters out monthly idiosyncratic price noise, creating a significantly more stable historical volatility anchor. In approved alpha 48f2f183, a wider realized volatility lookback was the decisive factor that boosted Sharpe to 1.73 and Fitness to 1.31 under decay=8. Targets Sharpe >= 1.35 and Fitness >= 1.10 with zero portfolio self-correlation.
confounders: Sustained quarterly market rallies compressing realized Parkinson volatility across all equities
Sparse trading volume in 1-year options in small-cap instruments
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha underperforms if 90-day Parkinson realized volatility fails to capture the true underlying price variance.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutral 1-year call implied volatility relative to 90-day Parkinson realized volatility baseline

hypotheses.title: 1-Year Call VRP Tail Conviction via Group Z-Score (implied_volatility_call_360) (option8)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Enhances the Batch 171 Candidate 2 baseline by substituting uniform group ranking with cross-sectional standardization (group_zscore). Uniform ranking compresses extreme volatility mispricings into a flat linear distribution. By contrast, group_zscore preserves relative dispersion, allocating high conviction weights to equities where 1-year call implied volatility trades 2 to 3 standard deviations above peer realized Parkinson volatility. This amplifies PnL velocity and risk-adjusted returns, driving Sharpe >= 1.30 and Fitness >= 1.05 while maintaining disciplined 11%-13% turnover.
confounders: Extreme positive outliers in illiquid single-stock options distorting group mean calculations
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha breaks down if extreme positive z-score outliers underperform median ranked volatility ratios.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry cross-sectional z-score of 1-year call implied volatility relative to 60-day Parkinson volatility

hypotheses.title: 1-Year Call VRP with 90d Close-to-Close Historical Volatility (implied_volatility_call_360) (option8)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Replaces high-low Parkinson intraday volatility with 90-day close-to-close historical volatility (historical_volatility_90). While Parkinson volatility captures intraday extremes, close-to-close historical volatility is immune to bid-ask bounce and intraday liquidity gaps. Pairing 1-year call implied volatility with 90-day historical volatility produces a pure, low-noise variance risk premium signal that isolates structural option overpricing with ultra-low portfolio churn (< 12%) and zero self-correlation.
confounders: Intraday volatility spikes that do not reflect in daily closing prices
Regime shifts in the equity volatility term structure
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if 90-day close-to-close volatility understates actual price dispersion relative to option implied volatility.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutral 1-year call implied volatility relative to 90-day close-to-close historical volatility
